open CategoryTheory
universe u
namespace AlgebraicGeometry
namespace Adelic

section Probe
variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne X]
    [Algebra k X.functionField] [IsConstantField k X] (U₀ U₁ : X.Opens)

-- Converse of chi_eq_of_bump: the ledger implies the bump, in three lines.
example (hledger : ∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, chi k U₀ U₁ D = chi k U₀ U₁ 0 + degK k D) :
    ∀ (P : X.PrimeDivisor) (E : X.WeilDivisor),
      chi k U₀ U₁ (pointDivisor P + E) = chi k U₀ U₁ E + residueDeg k P := by
  intro P E
  rw [hledger (pointDivisor P + E), hledger E, degK_add, degK_pointDivisor]
  ring

end Probe

-- does IsNoetherian give IsLocallyNoetherian?
example (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] : IsLocallyNoetherian X := inferInstance

end Adelic
end AlgebraicGeometry
